title: MarketLab
summary: Local market-making research, explicit simulated fill assumptions, and a deterministic exchange sandbox.
evidence: Causal research/execution separation with synthetic demonstration evidence.
limitation: Synthetic demos and simulated fills are labeled; no real profitability claim.
decisions: Research and matching sandbox are separate
Avoid treating synthetic participant matching as evidence of historical fill quality.
Keep trades, balances, deduplication and recovery inspectable.
Local simulator, not an authenticated multi-user venue.
Python calculations with a buildless UI
Keep analysis authoritative in one backend and remove bundler/runtime services.
Standard-library server is scoped to loopback use.
